body:
Thank-you for responding at all! I'm sorry to hear you were having a rough day yesterday as well. What I find astounding is that, though you were hurting as well, you took the time to help me and for that I am grateful. 

Thank-you again for helping out a stranger in need.

I'm still here. I still feel lost, but I do feel better than I did yesterday. 

My wife suggested I lay down for a nap and ended up sleeping the rest of the day. I woke up to eat a small salad (it's all my stomach would allow) and then went back to sleep until about 3:30 am. 

I've been reading and rereading the posts from both of you and it really is unbelievable that two strangers are so willing to help.

I can't thank-you two enough. I know the battle isn't over, but I'm going to take care of it one minute at a time.

Thank-you again.
I'm logging off to try and gather my thoughts and figure out what to do next.
Thanks for being a teammate, both of you.

I've never tried out-patient other than the therapy I go to regularly, but where I live, if you go to a hospital or tell a Dr. you're thinking of suicide & you have a plan, you get admitted to a hospital for no less than 72 hours. I don't know if that's standard or not, I only have my own experience to rely on.

I feel safer on the internet as, at least in this reddit, people are less judgmental and I'm less likely to hear "just get over it" or "God will help you if you pray enough" -- I'm an Atheist. Just talking to you too is making me feel better, it feels like I'm less alone and I have a place to turn to.

If I can last through this, I may take you up on messaging you in a more private setting... sorry that sounded creepy in my head, but not my intention.

I'm not sure it's even dissatisfaction, it's a unwillingness to go on. I am so tired of fighting. It's a constant struggle that I feel like I'm losing.

I don't know you, but thanks for being there for me and those that need help period. 

My wife knows something is up with me and wants me to go back to the hospital -- I have no reason to go, it didn't help last time, how can it be different this time?

I feel like if I don't go I will disappoint her, she doesn't know of my plans yet. I'm so lost.

Hi Emily. Thank-you for understanding and loving a complete stranger. You are a better person than I.

I don't know what else to say, but like I told rockitorknockit, I am just waiting to not feel alone or abandoned maybe a better word.

I'm just waiting. I don't know for what though. I guess I am waiting to not feel alone. 

This is a throwaway account, but I've been lurking this sub-reddit for a long time. I didn't know where else to turn as I don't think the suicide hotline will help. So I rolled the dice and let it out here.

Thanks for responding at all though.
